title: pipeline.json
description: Manifest of canonical scripts required to reproduce a study's analytical pipeline. Consumed by tooling/pipeline-viewer/.

study.description: Short identifier of the study this pipeline belongs to (e.g. 'study2-chile-v2').

target.description: One-paragraph statement of what the pipeline produces and the identification strategy it implements.

version.description: Manifest schema version for the *study* (not for this JSON Schema). Bump when canonical step set changes meaningfully.

last_updated.description: ISO date the manifest was last edited.

notes.description: Free-form notes about conventions, exclusions, and how to keep the manifest in sync.

label.description: Short human-readable label (snake_case recommended). Should match the script's stem.

path.description: Relative path from the study root to the script.

language.description: Implementation language. Suggested values: 'python', 'R', 'sh', 'stata', 'matlab'. Open enum.

stage.description: Pipeline stage the step belongs to (e.g. 'data_prep', 'crosswalk', 'imputed_positions', 'estimation'). Open enum.

status.description: Implementation status. Suggested values: 'implemented', 'todo'. Open enum; the viewer renders unknown values as a neutral pill.

description.description: Plain-text paragraph describing what the step does. Rendered as preformatted text in the viewer; newlines preserved.

inputs.description: Paths or glob patterns the step reads.

depends_on.description: List of step ids this step depends on. Must reference existing step ids and form an acyclic graph (enforced by tooling/pipeline-viewer/check.py, not the schema).
